weeklyPlan.focus: Eval fundamentals and your first golden set
weeklyPlan.buildTask: Collect 30 real or realistic NuraKnect DMs with the reply you would accept. Write run_eval.py that scores each reply pass/fail and prints the pass rate. Commit the baseline.
weeklyPlan.pythonTask: 20 min daily: build the exact-match and F1 scorer, then read JSONL files and compute metrics per category.

weeklyPlan.focus: LLM-as-judge, RAG evals and agent evals
weeklyPlan.buildTask: Write a judge prompt with a rubric and run it on 30 replies. Label the same 30 yourself. Score your RAG pipeline from layer 2 with RAGAS faithfulness and context precision.
weeklyPlan.pythonTask: 20 min daily: implement Cohen's kappa and the regression gate; practise computing confusion matrices by hand.

weeklyPlan.buildTask: Pick one of Langfuse, LangSmith or Helicone and trace NuraKnect's DM pipeline. Finish the judge calibration report: agreement, kappa, and three disagreements explained.
weeklyPlan.pythonTask: 20 min daily: practise decorators and context managers, which is how tracing libraries wrap your calls.

weeklyPlan.focus: Safety: prompt injection, guardrails, red teaming, CI
weeklyPlan.buildTask: Write 20+ injection attempts against the DM assistant, measure attack success rate, add a guardrail, re-measure, and add a CI job that runs the evals and fails on a drop.
weeklyPlan.pythonTask: 20 min daily: build the naive prompt-injection detector with regexes and score its precision and recall.
